rows.owned_state: Scoped immutable sensitive versions; coherent bounded credential sets; write_new/read/delete
rows.handoff: Required durable write acknowledgement precedes publication. Unknown write is no usable publication proof; orphan cleanup does not establish exchange outcome. Keep material needed by valid uses; deletion never erases refresh consumption

rows.owned_state: Stable connection/owner/fixed target, enabled/revoked facts, active generation/version reference, semantic revision and private publication fence
rows.handoff: Serialize terminal revoke, replacement, publication and final dispatch admission. Readiness is a current fact reduction, not an independently writable status. Unknown metadata refuses; provider revoke outcome is separate

rows.owned_state: One logical owner's acquisition correlation, admitted origin/scope/profile/registration, repair relation, one-use completion and terminal result
rows.handoff: Protected-entry/code correlation is consumed once before exchange; current scope checked again before publication. Custody then metadata acknowledgement precede completed. Unknown exchange never grants resend; gateway cannot move/recreate the owner

rows.owned_state: Per-source rotating-material alias association, reservation/current fence, authorize-once consumption, stored response and publication/recovery record
rows.handoff: Authorize consumes source and invalidates admissions atomically before send. Only the original live acknowledged winner sends once. Lost response/owner is uncertain; acknowledged stored response permits publication-only recovery. No lease or backup can make a consumed source reusable

rows.owned_state: Immutable capture association and generation evidence/provenance; transient inspected/admitted transport pins
rows.handoff: Capture alone grants nothing. Recover verifiable snapshot association or capture/validate anew, subject to refresh alias uniqueness. Final dispatch participates in connection/refresh fencing; missing snapshot or stale evidence refuses without rereading mutable sources

rows.owned_state: Optional bounded exact-target evidence with original collection/deadline and binding coordinates
rows.handoff: Cache loss supplies neither denial nor success. Re-collection requires the existing admitted F08 budget or refusal. No independent durable database or permission grant is implied

rows.owned_state: Durable prepare, dispatch/abort fence and first terminal outcome for one immutable attempt
rows.handoff: Prepare grants no send; only the original live acknowledged gate winner sends once. Recovery never sends. Pre-gate abort races atomically with dispatch; unknown gate or terminal persistence keeps conservative recovery knowledge

rows.owned_state: Exact namespace/key/fingerprint index, reservation-to-attempt link, retained result and settlement/expiry
rows.handoff: Reserve plus Prepared attempt is one atomic write; terminal settlement plus replay state/times is another. Pending/Quarantined never expire automatically; known-result expiry is generation-safe. Capacity refuses new reservations, never evicts live deduplication facts

rows.owned_state: Executing leaf's issuer/reference tombstone, canonical subject and one Prepared attempt link; at most one successful redemption per attempt
rows.handoff: Acknowledged spend is separate from the dispatch gate. Unknown spend grants no gate/send; spent then aborted stays spent. Direct and gateway ingress share this owner. First-profile tombstones have no automatic expiry; capacity refuses new spending

Atomic durable consume precedes entry; ambiguous acknowledgement grants no entry. Recheck current proof/key/policy/time/deadline after acknowledgement. Retire only at trustworthy lower >= exp; uncertain time/restart extends retention

rows.owned_state: Each admitting hop's durable admission anchor and linked outcome observation, with safe correlation
rows.handoff: Unacknowledged admission blocks dispatch. Final append failure preserves known business effect and reports incomplete audit; it does not retry the effect. Gateway and leaf audits are distinct and not one transaction. Required retained audit outlives replay payload deletion

rows.owned_state: Exact scope/epoch/selection, attempt/predecessor, immutable classified view and matching private observation index
rows.handoff: Publish whole view/index atomically under current source/material/policy/deadline fences. Stale attempt discarded; unknown acknowledgement observed by same attempt. Recover verifiable continuity or invalidate handles/new epoch. Bounded eviction is not disappearance

rows.owned_state: Fixed child/parent/observation/target relation, private route evidence revision and current validation
rows.handoff: Same-target CAS checks current observation, parent generation, independent admission and child enablement/revocation; invalidates old admissions/verification. Unknown acknowledgement grants no forward. Route change cannot repoint a connection; unavailable private proof/port refuses

rows.owned_state: Serving endpoint's one-use establishment authority and redemption decision
rows.handoff: Redeem before data; distinct from approval, transport nonce and renewable data lease. A supporting authority binding must prevent reuse across its selected ingress/replica/restart scope. Loss of continuity cannot recreate an accepted establishment token; exact ledger/format remains an advertisement prerequisite

rows.owned_state: One live owner's serialized state, first terminal fact, lease/revoke/drain decisions and task/resource accounting
rows.handoff: Enforce the existing 2 s data cutoff and 5 s teardown, independently at controlled endpoints. Restart/continuity loss is lost, never reattach or reconstructed live leases. Durable terminal records, if selected, do not restore live sockets/devices or permit token reuse

rows.owned_state: Optional bounded read cache/context/key/expiry; no second discovery view or mutation-result authority
rows.handoff: Default ephemeral cursor-key loss invalidates continuations. Discovery cursors refer to DiscoveryPublicationPort's immutable view and cannot retain it past its limits. Cache absence proves no provider absence. Durable subscription checkpoints are a different deferred port

rows.owned_state: Authoritative admitted instance/operation/profile/route/configuration/projection meaning and selected issuer/trust policy inputs
rows.handoff: Deployment files/artifacts may supply immutable configuration; no live configuration database is implied. Effective connection facts belong to ConnectionAuthorityPort. A configuration backup cannot reset another port's uniqueness or revive old identities, target bindings, grants or private history

rows.owned_state: Conceptual one-shot event-derived claim, separate from event receipt and mutation attempt
rows.handoff: Exact claim ingress/proof remains unbound. An event or its persisted receipt is not approval. This named future owner cannot advertise spending until its dedicated proof/issuer/ingress contract is settled

limitation: Textual inventory extraction, not a port implementation or atomicity proof.
